name: Rival's Challenge

start.dialog: So you're the hero everyone's talking about? Heh. I'm Seifer. I'm gonna be the legendary knight someday. But first, I need to prove I'm better than you. Fight me! Winner takes the glory!
start.objective: Defeat Seifer in a one-on-one duel

progress.dialog: Not bad! But I'm just getting started! Hyne, grant me strength!
progress.objective: Continue the duel and defeat Seifer

complete.dialog: ...I lost. But I won't lose next time! This isn't over! Here - take this. My old gunblade. I've outgrown it. But it'll serve you... until I win it back!

party_comments.kade: He's strong. And stubborn. We'll meet again.
party_comments.korr: A rival can drive you to greater heights. Or destroy you.
party_comments.twist: That was intense! He really doesn't like losing!

hidden_outcome: If you defeat Seifer using only counterattacks, he respects you as a true rival and gives you 'Demon Slice' technique
